## Description

`r meta$description`

## Variable operationalization


```{r var_descript,echo = FALSE}
vars = meta$variables  

vars = vars[unlist(lapply(names(vars), function(x) x%in%colnames(dt)))]

tmp=data.table('Variable'=names(vars))
tmp[, 'Operationalization':=unlist(vars)]

kable(tmp, caption = 'Variable operationalization') #%>%kable_styling()
```

## Descriptive statistics

```{r descr, echo = F}
for (.var in colnames(dt)) {
  print(summary(dt[, .var,with=F]))
  cat('\n\n')
}

```
